Professional Update | Regular Bail Granted by the Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Patna
I am grateful to have had the opportunity to appear before the Hon’ble High Court and assist the Court in the matter on behalf of the petitioner.
I am pleased to share a recent matter in which I had the privilege of appearing on behalf of the petitioner before the Hon’ble High Court of Judicature at Patna in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 55132 of 2026, arising out of Goh P.S. Case No. 16 of 2026, District Aurangabad.
The matter concerned a prayer for regular bail in connection with an offence punishable under Section 96 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.
The submissions advanced on behalf of the petitioner primarily addressed the petitioner’s period of custody, clean criminal antecedents, and the statement of the victim recorded before the learned Magistrate under Section 183 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023. The relevant materials collected during investigation were also placed before the Hon’ble Court for its consideration.
After hearing the parties and considering the circumstances and submissions placed on record, the Hon’ble Court was pleased to allow the bail application and direct the release of the petitioner on bail, subject to the conditions stipulated in the order dated 12 August 2026.
I am grateful for the opportunity to assist the Hon’ble Court and represent the petitioner in this matter.
The complete order of the Hon’ble Patna High Court is annexed to this post for professional and academic reference.
This post is shared strictly for professional and academic purposes. It is not intended to comment upon the merits of the pending proceedings or to express any opinion regarding the guilt or innocence of any person.
Kumar Bal Govind Singh
Advocate | Patna High Court
